content: On the MR extraction task, ELMo with encoder multi-decoder architecture and BERT with encoder-decoder with encoders pretrained on the summarization task perform the best. The best-performing models improve our baseline's dosage and frequency extractions ROUGE-1 F1 scores from 54.28 and 37.13 to 89.57 and 45.94, respectively.
